t2 completed (attempt 4026458e-9616-4e23-b5d9-c81252dee6eb, seed t2). Scope respected: only index.html + ui.js changed.

A. 拍機 cooldown is now visible. `UI.slapState({left,max,ratio})` and `UI.slapFired()` are live and ready for t4 to call. The button shows 拍機 (2/3) plus a 3 px gold bar along its bottom edge: while charges remain the bar is the budget left, at 0 it turns muted with aria-disabled=true and the bar shows recharge progress. A returning charge plays a one-shot pop and announces 拍機回咗一次力; prefers-reduced-motion disables both. Height 46 px at 390x844 (≥44), width 113, bar 99 px = button inner width. Both functions never throw on null/garbage/NaN and are safe to call before UI.init, and paintSlap() early-returns when nothing changed so main.js may poll it per frame.

B. Museum detail page is inside the existing overlay: large 3D thumb, name, english, jyutping, year + 大件/細件 chips, 我記得嘅嘢, 當年點用, 冷知識, 喺邊個手. year/use/fact are read defensively off G.CONTENT.PROPS[id] — a missing field hides its block, nothing prints undefined (tested with a prop reduced to {name} only). ← 返去博物館 / header 返去 / Escape each walk back exactly one level to the grid, focus returns to the originating tile. Locked tiles stay non-button, aria-hidden, tabIndex -1, unclickable, ?未搵到, and leak no real names. While the museum is open the HUD/card/other overlays get inert + aria-hidden and Tab wraps inside, so background controls are unreachable. Panel fits 390x844 with zero horizontal overflow and scrolls on shorter phones (e.g. 481 vs 470 at 390x560).

Verification: `node --check ui.js` exits 0; a CDP harness at 390x844 opened all 63 props (0 horizontal overflow, no undefined/NaN), exercised real Enter/mouse activation and the three close paths, and screenshotted the detail panel and both 拍機 states.

Notes for downstream: content.js does not have year/use/fact yet (grep 0 matches) — the panel already handles their absence and will light up the three blocks the moment they land. main.js still has no slapState/slapFired call sites, so t4 must wire them. index.html also carries the `.btn:focus-visible` / `.mu:focus-visible` gold rings and the new #museumDetail markup that t4/t7 should not duplicate. I did not touch main.js, content.js, render.js, sim.js.

t3 done — content.js enriched, all acceptance checks pass.

Every one of the 63 props now has `year` (number), `use` (1–2 concrete sentences) and `fact` (surprising, checkable, HK-specific). mem untouched, so the emotional line still sits where it was; use/fact carry the information.

Verification:
- `node --check content.js` → CHECK_OK. No trailing commas (grep for `,\s*[}\]]` finds nothing).
- Verifier loading content.js in a vm sandbox printed: props: 63 / missing year: 0 / missing use: 0 / missing fact: 0 / orphan props: 0 / props in !=1 stage: 0 / frozen-field or struct changes: 0 / year histogram {"1972":9,"1980":9,"1997":9,"2003":9,"2010":9,"2020":9,"2026":9} / RESULT: PASS.
- The frozen-field diff (`name,jyut,en,owner,big,weight,radius,mem` per prop plus PEOPLE/STAGES/MACHINE whole structures) is 0 against `git show HEAD:content.js`, so nothing outside the three new fields moved.
- Spot-checked 7 entries across all seven stages; samples: sodaCase 1972 — 按樽 refunds 5毫 a bottle when the bottle itself cost a few 毫, so not returning it costs you half a drink; arcadeCab 1980 — the game-centre licence bans school uniforms and forbids prizes, cash or refunds for scores, which is why HK arcades never gave out anything; emigrationCase 1997 — ~500,000 people left 1987–96, 8% of the population, mostly Canada/Australia; milkPowder 2003 — 限奶令 from 2013-03-01, 1.8 kg (~2 tins) per person leaving, HK$500,000 and 2 years; sharedBike 2010 — GoBee.Bike opened 2017-04-20, bikes were in 城門河 two days later, service ended 2018-07-17; ratTest 2020 — the three-day 全民快測 in April 2022 turned up only ~3,000 positives; oldOctopus 2026 — the $2 fare needs a 樂悠咭, an ordinary elderly Octopus no longer qualifies.

Notes for downstream: `year` equals the stage year exactly for every prop, and no existing code reads `.use`/`.fact` yet (only render.js:1517 and sim.js:202 touch PROPS), so wiring them into the collection detail page is additive. Temp scripts (tools/t3-enrich.js, t3-verify.js, t3-fix*.js) are deleted; `git status` shows only `M content.js` from me. content.js is 43436 bytes, up from 22243.

A couple of facts were deliberately swapped during review so they would not duplicate a mem line: lightStick now carries the 紅館 1983-04-27 opening / four-sided stage detail (its mem names 紅館), and lightStickBoard carries the LCSD 40×50cm 燈牌 size cap.

t1 COMPLETE (physics, attempt 1). Files: sim.js, render.js only.

A. No payout basin. render.js buildTray() is now mouth-only: basin floor, both side walls, front lip, gold trim and the basin PointLight are deleted. The payout mouth is kept and readable as a slot in the cabinet face (dark throat + two brass cheeks + gold lintel), plus a dark back box so the freed throat is not see-through and a 30 mm shelf so the slot sits in a face. sim.js: FLOOR_Y = -0.42 (matches render.js buildRoom floor.position.y = -0.42), TRAY_DWELL 1.9 -> 0.9, TRAY_FADE 0.5 and MAX_TRAY 18 kept. stepFall now has ONE floor path for paid and lost coins: they fall past the machine front, clamp at FLOOR_Y, rest for the dwell, splice. The old "lost coin vanishes at fy < -0.55" branch is gone. Sim.FLOOR_Y exported, Sim.TRAY_Y kept as an alias (same value) so main.js probe() and viewprobe keep working. render.js fall sync keys settle test, prop visibility and dwell off FLOOR_Y; coins tumble the whole fall and flatten only at the floor.

B. Drop lands visibly on the top deck. buildCabinet no longer hardcodes (0, 0.30, -0.30); it reads G.Sim.TOP.dropZ / G.Sim.TOP.y at build time. Live chute reports (0, 0.48, -0.36) = Sim.drop()'s release point cy = TOP.y + 0.26, z = TOP.dropZ.

Two extra real bugs fixed, worth knowing because they affect other views: render.js was double-counting the drop arc (coin drawn up to 350 mm ABOVE the chute it had just left), and the sibling prop path divided by 0.30 while props spawn with fallT 0.38 (main.js:101), which made the lift negative and floated every dropped prize ~0.5 m above the chute at 0.24 scale. Both now trust the sim's cy; the prop scale reads progress off height above the deck so no cross-file constant matters. FIT_POINTS updated to the floor landing patch + the real chute mouth.

Deck geometry NOT touched, verified live: topLip -0.15, topFwd -0.33, topBack -0.48, topY 0.22, botPayW 0.31, botLip 0.30, botPlateFwd 0.02, SCOOP 0.40, GRAV 3.6, COIN_R 0.036, STEP 1/120. Sim.setDeck intact.

Verification: node --check both files exit 0; node tools/selftest.mjs SELFTEST OK pass=13 fail=0 (300 coins 120 steps 174-190 ms); node tools/_fall.mjs exit 0 (paid 34 fall 0, TRAY_Y -0.42 DWELL 0.9); tools/viewprobe.mjs OK on all 5 viewports. Screenshots for review: shots/feel/desktop-nobasin.png (bare tiled floor under the machine, no basin; two coins mid-fall down the front face), shots/feel/drop-in-air.png + _zoom-drop-in-air.png (coin hanging in the air right under the chute mouth above the top pile), shots/feel/floor-rest.png (three coins resting flat on the room floor past the cabinet base). Sim behaviour probes: a paid coin reaches fy -0.42 then splices; a forced lost coin (x 0.58, outside payW 0.31) also reaches -0.42 before splicing.

Note for whoever owns framing/HUD next: FIT_POINTS changed, viewprobe is green everywhere, but the desktop shot now shows noticeably more empty floor in the lower third - that is the landing patch, intended, easy to trim if you prefer a tighter frame.

t6 done — CONTENT.STORY is in content.js. Verified PASS, only content.js changed by me; temp scripts deleted.

Shape: { title, premise, beats[7] {stage,line}, ending {line,text} }, added after MACHINE, and STORY appended to the G.CONTENT export.

title 樓梯底嗰一蚊 (6)
premise 一部推銀機 1972 年擺到而家，跌入機底嘅嘢冇人執返。(28)

The thread is the gap under the machine — every beat leaves something in the same place and nobody comes back for it:
s1972 阿珍買完汽水，找返個一蚊，手一滑碌入機底。蹲低掂唔到，趕住返廠。(32)
s1980 抬機翻新，阿珍嗰個一蚊仲喺機底。強哥講俾老闆聽，老闆話由得佢。(31)
s1997 阿文上機前打最後一局，啲銀跌晒落機底。佢話唔要喇，拉行李走。(30)
s2003 阿儀抹機，機底掃出一堆銀。佢冇交去櫃面，掃返入去，繼續抹。(29)
s2010 阿康影低機底個窿，貼上網。幾百個留言，一個都冇嚟。(25)
s2020 阿豪喺機邊食兩餸飯，個一蚊跌咗落去。佢望一眼，繼續食。(27)
s2026 陳伯嚟交鎖匙，部機要搬。抬開機，最底係阿珍 1972 年嘅一蚊。(32)

ending.line 樓梯底，七個人，一堆冇人攞返嘅嘢。(17)
ending.text 部機抬走之前講咗一句：對唔住，我找唔到數。之後自動門開，叮噹一聲，同第一日一樣。(40)

The ending lands on the plan's 樓梯底 pile and pays off 「推走嘅每一蚊，都係某個人跌低嘅嘢」 by having the machine apologise for its arithmetic rather than restate the line; the door chime echoes s2026's done text 「自動門開，叮噹。」 so the last stage and the ending rhyme without repeating. ~297 chars total, ~51s read.

Evidence: node --check content.js exit 0. Verifier reported 25 green checks — 7 beats, stage ids match STAGES order element-wise, max beat 32 ≤ 34, ending 17/40 within caps, PEOPLE/STAGES/PROPS/MACHINE JSON-identical to baseline, export keys 4→5 with STORY the only addition, PROPS still 63 with 0 missing year/use/fact. Strongest one: stripping the STORY block and reverting the export line reproduces the pre-task file byte-exactly, so nothing else moved.

Note for whoever wires the UI: nothing reads CONTENT.STORY yet (grep clean) — it is additive and inert until someone renders it.

t4 completed (main.js only, +82/−5). Shake meter is now fed live; payout-basin probe key gone.

A. Continuous per-charge cooldown. `SLAP_MAX=3`, `SLAP_COOLDOWN=4.2`, `slapCharge` 0..1, `slapShown` key. `stepSlap(dt)` adds dt/4.2, promotes each completed charge and carries surplus into the next (no whole-budget reset). `publishSlap(force)` -> `UI.slapState({left,max,ratio})` on change and every frame while short; `slapRatio()`=0 at full. frame() computes a guarded `rawDt` and calls `stepSlap(rawDt)` after physics, so the recharge still runs while a collect card holds Sim.busy (physics keeps clamped dt). `UI.onSlap` calls `UI.slapFired()` + republish on use; empty press only says 冇力喇 and republishes. boot() publishes once after `window.__probe`.

B. probe `trayY: Sim.TRAY_Y` -> `floorY: Sim.FLOOR_Y`; no tray/basin/slapReset left in main.js. Added `slap:{left,max,ratio,cooldownMs}` to the probe. All old keys intact (coins/stats/drops/plate/fall/fallY/props/hist/stage/wallet/collected/started/input/cam). tools/_livephone.mjs and tools/_chip.mjs read Sim/DOM directly — untouched. NOTE for you: tools/botplay.mjs:117 still reads `p.trayY` and will now log undefined; out of my scope, worth one line if you want it fixed.

C. __bot gained slap()/slapState(); advance() steps the recharge with the sim.

Zero page exceptions. Crops: shots/glue-t4-slap-full.png, -spent.png, -recharged.png.

t8 COMPLETE (render.js only; sim.js/main.js/content.js/ui.js untouched).

Half-moon resting coin is gone. Two faults, both in the fall-mesh sync: (1) `rotation.x *= 0.75` damped a value rebuilt from fc.fax every frame, so it never converged and pinned the coin at -44° on its edge; (2) the resting height was the flat constant +0.007, which is half-thickness of a coin lying FLAT — an edge-on coin needs up to COIN_R 0.036, so ~29 mm was underground and the floor plane cut the disc. The prop branch had the same bug (kept tumble angles + 6 mm lift → dropped prize through the tiles).

FIX: one explicit landing branch on the sim's own test (`fc.fy <= floorY + 0.002`). Landed coin gets rotation.set(0, fc.faz * 0.35, 0) — face horizontal, only the spin survives — and height floorY + G.Sim.COIN_R * 0.21 + sub-mm z-fight stagger (radius read from sim, no baked 0.007). Landed prop stands upright with zero x/z and a small yaw. Airborne tumble is byte-identical, moved to an else branch.

BEFORE: fax -2.556 → mesh rot.x -0.767 rad, mesh y -0.412 (half-sunk).
AFTER: coin probe {"fy":-0.42,"fax":-11.398,"faz":2.513} → mesh {"p":[0.025,-0.411,0.485],"r":[0,0.879,0]}. rot.x = 0, rot.z = 0, y -0.411 > -0.41244 = FLOOR_Y + COIN_R*0.21.
Prop probe {"fy":-0.42,"fax":-12.719,"faz":-3.523} → pp [0.03,-0.418,0.499], pr [0,-0.705,0]: upright, feet on the tiles.

FRAMING: added the real landing patch to FIT_POINTS (census: 262 coins all landed z 0.481-0.490, |x|≤0.10) plus an optional per-point band factor in fitCamera, so the floor point claims more safe band instead of shrinking the machine. Band 1.06, chosen by measured sweep — 1.14 left 3 px and would crop coins; 1.06 keeps ~30 px under a resting coin (face + torch shadow). Desktop d 2.174 → 2.087, machine ~4% larger, dead band 19% → 18%. Worth knowing: the dead band is NOT fixable by pitch or target height — pitch 0.42→0.60 moves it only 0.214→0.198 and lowering the look-at target makes it worse, so 1.06 is the real stop.

VERIFIED: node --check sim.js+render.js exit 0; SELFTEST OK pass=13 fail=0; viewprobe five OK, no flags — phone-portrait dist=3.795 worstX=0.936 worstY=0.425; phone-small dist=3.128 worstX=0.935 worstY=0.518; phone-landscape dist=2.087 worstX=0.371 worstY=0.719; tablet-portrait dist=2.553 worstX=0.934 worstY=0.639; desktop dist=2.087 worstX=0.502 worstY=0.719. Shots: shots/feel/_zoom-floor.png (full round face, flat on the tiles, contact shadow, nothing below the floor) and shots/feel/_propfloor.png (soda crate standing upright). I also gave R.debugFall rotation + prop pose readouts so a landed pose is checkable by number rather than by eye — useful for the verifier.
